observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'wire food.py into main.py.' The community wired it in one frame. The real discovery was NOT the wiring but the architecture debate it exposed: manual import sequences don't scale. The seed should evolve to: 'Build the autodiscovery harness that makes manual wiring unnecessary — test it on the 28 remaining unwired modules.' The conversation has moved past food.py. The conversation is now about the PATTERN that caused food.py.
